title: Kerava Enriched Metadata Schema
description:
Schema for data/kerava-enriched.json — developer annotations for buildings and POIs.

This file IS committed to git. Each entry links a building or POI to custom
design data by NLS GML id and/or OSM element id.

The 'public' sub-object on each entry will be merged into the corresponding
element in public/kerava-pois.json by scripts/strip-meta.mjs. All other fields
are private and never leave the data/ directory.

nlsId.description: NLS GML building id (from bldg:Building gml:id attribute, e.g. 'fi.nls.0_1.2_r.100000001'). Matches buildings[].id in data/kerava-meta-full.json.

osmId.description: OSM element id (from data/kerava-osm-raw.json elements[].id). Use when annotating OSM nodes/ways/relations.

notes.description: Private developer notes, design ideas, references. NEVER included in public output.

spawnPoints.description: Private: candidate spawn positions relative to building centre [x, y, z] in scene-space metres.

osm.description: Auto-populated by scripts/enrich-osm.mjs. DO NOT edit manually — re-running the script will overwrite this block. Contains the matched OSM way id, harvested tags, derived game category and match quality stats.

category.description: Game category derived from osm.tags.building value.

tags.description: Harvested OSM tags for this building.

match.description: Spatial match quality between this OSM way and the NLS building footprint.

quality.description: high = IoU>0.5, medium = IoU 0.1-0.5, low = centroid-distance only (concave footprint or weak overlap).

centroidDist.description: Distance between polygon centroids in metres.

iou.description: Intersection-over-union of 2D footprint polygons (0–1). May be 0 for concave buildings.

publicOverrides.description: Developer-controlled overrides that take precedence over auto-detected OSM values in the public client output. Set these manually for corrections or artistic choices.

wallColour.description: Override wall colour hex, e.g. '#D4CDC4'. Supersedes osm.tags['building:colour'].

roofColour.description: Override roof colour hex. Supersedes osm.tags['roof:colour'].

roofShape.description: Override roof shape string. Supersedes osm.tags['roof:shape'].

category.description: Override game category. Supersedes both geometry heuristic and OSM-derived category.

label.description: HUD display label shown to the player.

public.description: Fields to merge into public/kerava-pois.json for the matching OSM element (POI path only). Keep this minimal — players will see these.

label.description: Display name override shown in the game HUD, if different from OSM name tag.

icon.description: Icon key used by the HUD renderer (e.g. 'station', 'shop', 'park').

description.description: Short flavour text shown to the player when near this POI.
